answer: Rotate the session key after every 50 completed tasks, and bind the new key to the work history rather than to the account. A receipt grades after three confirmations from unrelated clusters, drawn from a rotating auditor pool. Reusing an old key across identities is a flag, so a farm must rotate honestly or expose the link. Cost per clone: 50 real tasks before the first rotation and three outside reviews. The plume is the thin history a key carries, the relic is the key it replaces, and the tide of audits keeps turning both up.
